name: support_triage
title: Zendesk Support Triage & Slack Notification
description:
Automated support operations workflow for teams using Zendesk and Slack. Triggered by a webhook, this workflow handles the full lifecycle of an incoming support request in 4 steps: it provisions the requester as a Zendesk user, deduplicates any open tickets they already have (preventing duplicate agent work), opens a governed support ticket via the airlock, and posts a real-time alert to your Slack workspace via a direct webhook POST — no Slack module dependency required.

Trigger contract: POST a JSON body with fields: name (string), email (string, valid email), message (string), slack_channel_webhook (string, your Slack incoming webhook URL).

Dependencies: Requires jayy/zendesk-integration v1.3.0 or later to be installed. The Slack step uses a direct HTTP POST to your Slack Incoming Webhook URL — no separate Slack module required.

Setup: (1) Install jayy/zendesk-integration and configure the zendesk vault entry with subdomain, email, and api_token. (2) Create a Slack Incoming Webhook at api.slack.com/apps and copy the webhook URL. (3) Pass the webhook URL as slack_channel_webhook in your trigger payload. (contest:2026Q3)

body_template.text: New support ticket #{Create Support Ticket.id} opened for *{name}* ({email}). Subject: {Create Support Ticket.subject}
